properties.name: Native unconditional branch
properties.description: Native unconditional branch

Stops one active entity-based alarm suppression for an exact physical server by setting Enabled to false. Prerequisites: select an Intersight endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations, compute physical summaries, and alarm suppressions and can update alarm suppressions. The workflow escapes every user-provided OData string, requires exactly one organization, resolves one server across an exact Name-or-Serial lookup without silently selecting ambiguous matches, retains and validates the server Moid and concrete compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit SourceObjectType, and requires exactly one enabled suppression for that server. Suppression Name is optional but becomes necessary when multiple enabled suppressions exist. Before updating, the workflow requires a matching Entity relationship and AlarmRules to be absent or empty, so rule-based suppressions cannot be changed. A successful run confirms request acceptance only; it does not re-read or poll the final suppression state.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expectedServerMoid = sys.argv[2]
expectedServerObjectType = sys.argv[3]
results = payload.get("Results")
